Besu on track for Thursday Thank you to all the teams who shared their retrospectives on EthMagicians so far 🙏 While there are still some teams' perspectives missing, I tried to synthesize the different proposals into tentative action items: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/pectra-retrospective/22637/27 It would be ideal if we could get everyone's input in the next week or so (testnet releases obviously take priority over this 😛) so that we can get to agreement on next steps by the time we're putting out mainnet Pectra releases.

excerpts.content:
Thank you to all the teams who shared their retrospectives on EthMagicians so far 🙏  

While there are still some teams' perspectives missing, I tried to synthesize the different proposals into tentative action items: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/pectra-retrospective/22637/27

It would be ideal if we could get everyone's input in the next week or so (testnet releases obviously take priority over this 😛) so that we can get to agreement on next steps by the time we're putting out mainnet Pectra releases.
